Question
========
Which of the following lines of R code will produce an error when run?

Answerlist
----------
* `Sum(1:10)`
* `sum(1:10`
* `sum(1:10)`
* `round(3.14159, digits = 2)`
* `round(3.14159, digit = 2)`

Solution
========

Answerlist
----------
* Correct: R is case-sensitive, and there is no function called `Sum()` (only `sum()`), so this errors.
* Correct: the closing parenthesis is missing, so this errors.
* Incorrect: this is valid, complete R code, so it runs without error.
* Incorrect: this is valid, complete R code (`digits` is the correct argument name), so it runs without error.
* Correct: `round()` has no argument called `digit` (it's `digits`), so this errors.
